note.value: Paerennir was the captain of the Dragonship Indravagar, the first vessel to sink a Dark Elf Black Ark. The Eagle Claw bolt throwers of his ship were enchanted, giving them a potency which outmatched even the mystic evils surrounding a Black Ark.

A vessel carrying this Crystal may always fire any undamaged armaments; spells and other factors will not stop it from firing at its selected target. The only reason it will be unable to fire is if the ship is abandoned.
